---
title: "Uncertainty in topoplots"
---

This website presents aggregate figures from a study investigating how
different visual representations of uncertainty affect the interpretation of
topoplots.

The study compares adjacent plots, animation, bivariate corner, bivariate
range, confidence intervals, uncertainty markers, and a basic topoplot.

The [full analysis](Analysis.qmd) includes the rendered statistical output,
respondent-level tables, figures, and open-ended feedback.
